ref.substituent_description: (iPr)(NHBoc)CH-C(=O)-NH-CH(CH2CH2CH2-NH-C(=O)-NH2)-C(=O)-NH-aryl, with a solid wedge to iPr on the first stereocentre and a solid wedge to the CH2 chain on the second. The aryl benzene has HN (amide) at C1, CH2-N(Me)-C(=O)-O-CH2-(9-fluorenyl) at C3 (meta to the HN) and CH2OH at C4 (para to the HN, ortho to the CH2N group).
ref.notes: Typeset reference-style drawing. 13 double bonds = 4 C=O (urea, valine C=O, citrulline C=O, carbamate) + 3 in the central benzene + 3 in each of the two fluorene benzene rings. The fluorene central ring is five-membered with no double bonds. The label under the citrulline alpha-N is N with H beneath it.

ref.substituent_description: A chain reads H2N-C(=O)-NH-CH2CH2CH2- to a stereocentre (solid wedge to the chain) that carries C(=O)NH-aryl and an NH which acylates the next residue: a CH with iPr on a solid wedge and NHBoc, then C(=O)-NH.
